info.name: module-manager
info.description:
Postman collection for the Module Manager (MM) Go backend.

Base URL is driven by the `baseUrl` collection variable (default: http://localhost:8778, see `.env` -> `Port`).

Typical flow:
1. `Health Check` – verify the server is up.
2. `Set Path` – point MM at the parent folder containing your Node.js projects.
3. `Scan Main Folder` – list detected projects (supports `limit` / `offset` pagination); results are cached server-side and build the project index.
4. `Get Project By Id` – fetch a single project using an `id` returned by the scan.

request.description:
`GET /api/healthz` → `handlers.Health`

Simple liveness probe. Returns server time (IST zone, format `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss`) and a fixed message.

`POST /api/set-path` → `handlers.SetPath`

Sets the parent folder that subsequent scans will read from. The path is stored in memory (server state) and is not persisted across restarts.

Errors (400):
- `Invalid JSON` – malformed request body.
- `path cannot be empty` – missing/blank `path` field.

Success (200):
- Standard envelope returned by `utils.JsonResponse`: `message` = `path is set`, `data.path` echoes the stored path.

query.description: Max number of directory entries to return. Default: 20. Must be > 0.
Number of directory entries to skip before returning. Default: 0. Must be >= 0.

request.description:
`POST /api/main/scan` → `handlers.ScanFolder`

Scans the parent folder previously set via `/api/set-path`, reads its immediate subdirectories and returns basic info for each project (id, name, path, recursive size).

Query params:
- `limit` (optional, default 20)
- `offset` (optional, default 0)

Errors (400):
- `invalid limit` / `invalid offset` – non-numeric or out-of-range values.
- `folder does not exist.` / `path is not a directory/folder.` – bad stored path.

Call `Set Path` first, otherwise no folder is configured.

variable.description: Project id returned by `Scan Main Folder`. Ids are generated as `{index}{name}` (e.g. `1my-app`).

request.description:
`GET /api/project/{id}` → `handlers.GetProjectInfoById`

Looks up a single project from the in-memory index built by `POST /api/main/scan` – run `Scan Main Folder` first.

Path param:
- `id` – project id returned by the scan. Ids are generated while scanning as `{index}{name}`, where index is the 1-based position of the entry within the scanned page (e.g. `1my-app`).

Success (200):
- Standard envelope returned by `utils.JsonResponse`: `message` = `project details by id`, `data.project` = full `types.Project` (human-readable sizes in `total_size_str` / `node_modules_size_str`, git info in `latest_commit` / `latest_commit_date`, top-level entries listed in `list_files`).
- Note: `date_created`, `date_modified`, `package_manager`, `libraries` and `frameworks` are not populated by the current implementation (zero time / null).

Errors (500, plain text):
- Unknown id – or scan never ran – returns `h.Services.GetProjectInfoById No project with the id: <id>`.
